children: China's exports expanded 25% year-on-year in August in U.S. dollar terms, matching forecast and accelerating from the 23.9% growth in the previous month, while imports soared 28.2%, customs data showed on Tuesday.
Growth in imports compares with an 27.5% year-on-year increase in July and a forecast for a 30% rise.
